failure_modes: a coherent alternate SHADOW profile and route graph authorizes composition
a valid foreign route or module release is accepted in place of the profile-selected release
a wrong command, profile root, or authority epoch reaches composition
a verification marker names a release or guest image absent from the selected profile graph
a hostile Python profile payload triggers attribute behavior before exact-type rejection
governance hardening changes the ordinary Python and Rust composition root or effects

aaa.reason: Each regression arranges one alternate release graph, hostile profile payload, or governed coordinate, acts through the public binder or pure composer, and asserts the exact typed failure and empty effects; the golden replay observes unchanged Python and Rust roots.

reject_is_noop.reason: Composed governance mismatches return the canonical empty effect plan, while malformed verifier markers fail before composition or external effects.

nonclaims: The profile and route remain SHADOW and unmounted, and production authority remains NONE.
The Python governed marker is process-local and depends on a trusted imperative shell supplying the expected profile identifier and authority epoch.
This packet proves no real RISC0 route receipt, atomic ZenoLedger publication, durable nullifier consumption, migration, outbox reconciliation, or terminal-lifecycle closure.
The Rust tests are enforced by Cargo gates outside this Python evidence-packet schema; the packet itself does not elevate them into a machine-checked theorem.
Bounded regressions and one golden differential replay do not prove the whole economy or guarantee all value movement.
